purpose: Development and reviewer checklist, NOT certification of standards, mastery, Ministry approval, or completed specialist evaluation.

references.authority: Qatar Ministry of Education and Higher Education
references.title: Early Learning - Foundation Stage Grades 1 and 2
references.application: Age-appropriate foundation teaching; requires local teacher judgment

references.authority: Qatar Ministry of Education and Higher Education
references.title: Curriculum Section: national framework, standards and learning resources
references.application: Grade, subject, term, source page and intended objective mapping; NOT source permission or app approval

references.title: Teaching and Learning Toolkit: Phonics
references.application: Explicit systematic grapheme-phoneme modeling matched to learner needs; comprehension taught separately

references.title: Universal Design for Learning Guidelines 3.0
references.application: Engagement, representation and varied expression and interaction; not a curriculum certification

references.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2
references.application: Design toward WCAG 2.2 AA; focus, reflow, visible labels and pointer target checks

references.title: 2023 Global Education Monitoring Report: Technology in education
references.application: Learning benefit, equity, cost and human contact before feature expansion

references.title: Law No. 13 of 2016 on Personal Data Privacy Protection, Article 17
references.application: Child-directed-site privacy notice and parent rights; investigate if any personal data processing is proposed; seek qualified advice

references.title: Guidance Hub for Regulated Entities (PDPPL)
references.application: Review Qatar privacy compliance responsibilities before any accounts, analytics or recordings

references.title: Guidance on AI and children, version 3.0
references.application: Only relevant if later adding AI: safety, child privacy, transparency, inclusion, accountability

domains.requirement: Document objective, grade and term, original source PDF page, wording and assessment limitations
Review -ing/-and grapheme-phoneme models, vowel/consonant fidelity, full-word clarity and phonics sequence
Review every child-facing Arabic string, MSA vocabulary, RTL and cultural suitability; approval not inferred from translation

domains.reviewerRole: Primary years teaching and inclusion specialist
domains.requirement: Model before testing, graduated hints, no forced timers, varied ways to participate and age-appropriate feedback

domains.reviewerRole: Accessibility tester and adult iPhone/iPad testers
domains.requirement: Manual VoiceOver, hearing and normal/slow replay, 320/390/768px layouts, keyboard and interruption tests

domains.reviewerRole: App security lead and Qatar privacy/legal adviser if applicable
domains.requirement: No child data uploads, unnecessary accounts or tracking; legal review before adding identifiable data, voice, photos or analytics

domains.reviewerRole: Independent teacher plus adult parent testers
domains.requirement: Record item-specific Accept/Revise/Hold, what to change, date, version and role; protect identities

domains.reviewerRole: Content editor and Qatar cultural reviewer
domains.requirement: Use original/licensed images, books, voices and fonts; separately review Islamic/Qatar history material with specialists
